name: Exp_WAMI_Cloud_X2
summary: This EA trades based on the WAMI (Weighted Accumulation Movement Index) indicator combined with a cloud-based signal system, likely using Ichimoku-style cloud filters for trend confirmation. It enters long positions when WAMI signals upward momentum and price is above the cloud, and short positions when WAMI signals downward momentum and price is below the cloud. The X2 designation indicates an improved second version with refined entry/exit logic and risk management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于WAMI（加权累积运动指数）指标结合云层信号系统进行交易，可能使用类一目均衡图的云层过滤器进行趋势确认。当WAMI指示上涨动能且价格在云层上方时做多，当WAMI指示下跌动能且价格在云层下方时做空。X2标识表示改进的第二版本，优化了入场/出场逻辑和风险管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是结合WAMI指标和云层系统的双重趋势跟踪方法。WAMI指标通过加权累积计算衡量市场的运动强度和方向，当指标从负转正时产生做多信号，从正转负时产生做空信号。云层系统作为趋势过滤器，只有在价格位于云层上方时才接受做多信号，在云层下方时才接受做空信号，这有效减少了震荡行情中的虚假信号。出场条件可能包括WAMI反向交叉、价格穿越云层边界或固定的止盈止损目标。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式。资金管理方面，X2版本可能引入了移动止损或追踪止损来锁定利润，同时设置了最大持仓限制以防止单边过度风险暴露。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a dual trend-following approach combining the WAMI indicator with a cloud-based filtering system. The WAMI indicator measures market movement strength and direction through weighted accumulation calculations, generating long signals when the indicator crosses from negative to positive and short signals when crossing from positive to negative. The cloud system serves as a trend filter, accepting long signals only when price is above the cloud and short signals only when price is below the cloud, which effectively reduces false signals during ranging markets. Exit conditions likely include WAMI reverse crossovers, price breaching cloud boundaries, or fixed take-profit and stop-loss targets. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance proportional calculations. For money management, the X2 version likely incorporates trailing stops to lock in profits while setting maximum position limits to prevent excessive directional risk exposure.

pros: 双重趋势过滤系统（WAMI+云层）有效减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
云层过滤器能识别市场结构，避免在震荡区间频繁开仓
X2版本作为改进迭代，可能在信号稳定性和风控方面有优化
系统化交易逻辑清晰，规则明确，便于回测和优化
WAMI指标的加权累积特性对市场运动方向的捕捉较为敏感
pros_en: Dual trend filtering system (WAMI + cloud) effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Cloud filter identifies market structure, avoiding frequent trades in ranging zones
X2 version as an improved iteration likely has optimizations in signal stability and risk control
Systematic trading logic is clear with well-defined rules, facilitating backtesting and optimization
WAMI indicator's weighted accumulation characteristic is relatively sensitive in capturing market movement direction
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在横盘震荡市中容易产生连续亏损，缺乏市场状态识别机制
双重过滤虽然减少虚假信号，但也可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期利润
如果止损设置不当或为零，单笔交易可能承受较大亏损
缺乏波动率自适应机制，在高低波动环境下使用相同参数可能不适
WAMI指标在快速反转市场中可能滞后，导致出场不及时
cons_en: Trend-following strategies tend to produce consecutive losses in sideways ranging markets, lacking market state identification mechanism
While dual filtering reduces false signals, it can also cause entry delays, missing early trend profits
If stop-loss is improperly set or zero, a single trade maysustain significant losses
Lacks volatility adaptation mechanism, using the same parameters in high and low volatility environments may be suboptimal
WAMI indicator may lag in fast reversal markets, causing delayed exits
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在横盘行情中暂停交易或切换策略
引入动态止损机制，根据ATR自适应调整止损距离，适应不同波动环境
增加多时间周期确认，在高时间周期趋势方向一致时才开仓
improvements_en: Add market state identification module (e.g., ADX or volatility filter) to pause trading or switch strategy during sideways markets
Introduce dynamic stop-loss mechanism using ATR-adaptive stop distances to suit different volatility environments
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, only opening positions when the higher timeframe trend direction aligns

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能产生连续小额亏损，累积损失较大
如果默认止损为零且未启用追踪止损，单笔交易风险敞口不可控
缺乏最大回撤控制和日内亏损限制等资金管理安全网
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy may produce consecutive small losses in ranging markets, accumulating significant drawdown
If default stop-loss is zero and trailing stop is not enabled, single trade risk exposure is uncontrolled
Lacks money management safety nets such as maximum drawdown control and daily loss limits
